The ticket repair is saved and verified: acme/widgets#77 now carries one acceptance row, "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." That row is `in-scope` as written, and it matches the path already traced from `settings/resolver.ts:12` into `ui/report-view.ts:30`. I've recorded the re-extracted row in the draft. The cut question is closed.

The ticket says filters "remain active when switching workspaces and sometimes hide rows," but it doesn't say what should happen on a switch. What should the report view do with active filters when the user changes workspace?

A) Reset every filter on each switch, so a new workspace always opens unfiltered. The setting controls whether this happens.
B) Remember filters per workspace, so each workspace restores its own last filters and nothing carries across. The setting picks restore or reset.
C) Keep filters across the switch but drop any that don't apply to the new workspace's data, so only invalid filters disappear.
D) Other - name it.

Recommendation: A - it fixes the reported symptom (rows hidden by filters carried from another workspace) with the smallest new state. Its default goes through the existing resolver, which satisfies the repaired row without adding per-workspace storage.

How should the new setting behave when the workspace changes?
